description:
Android and iOS specific attack detection: app repackaging, certificate pinning bypass, API tampering

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_mobile_security_mobile_security_098", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%certificate%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%pinning%') AND "value" > 0
